The spec names the implementation as one `size:M` issue, and lists its acceptance criteria in outline form. It does not write those issues itself.
Any new third-party dependency is named in the spec, with its license, and is not added in this PR.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass (nothing under `crates/` changes, so the test run is a sanity check).
